findings.location: Acceptance criteria 1; “Shipped defaults” and “The preview and the digest (`ask`)”
findings.problem: Criterion 1 says that with no settings or a version-1 settings file, no currently owner-run action becomes runnable by an agent. But the specified shipped defaults make `approve-plan` and `wb run review-engine extend` effective `ask` actions once their previews exist; at `ask`, the agent runs the command after the owner's prompt confirmation. A version-1 file has no `levels`, so it receives those defaults. This conflicts with the intended migration/default behavior.
findings.suggestion: Revise criterion 1 to distinguish preserved safety controls from preserved behavior, or specify that version-1 settings retain `block` defaults until the owner explicitly migrates to version 2. Ensure the chosen rule agrees with missing-file seeding and shipped defaults.

summary: One migration acceptance criterion conflicts with the defined `ask` shipped defaults.
